A teacher in a tweed jacket sits on a folding chair nearby, observing the scene calmly. On the right side of the image, a robot with blinking lights waves its metallic arm. A cat with white fur sits on a table next to the robot, watching the mechanical movement. Behind the robot, a man in a red scarf holds a clipboard tightly. He is looking at a poster board covered in charts. A woman with glasses stands beside him, pointing at a specific graph. In the foreground, a beaker filled with green liquid rests on a wooden table. A magnifying glass lies next to the beaker, reflecting light softly. A rabbit in a small cage is placed on the floor near the table legs. A child in a yellow shirt kneels down to look at the rabbit. Another child with curly hair stands behind the kneeling child, holding a balloon. The balloon floats slightly above their head. A stack of books is piled on a distant desk. There is no digital screen visible in the scene. There is no smartphone being used by any attendee. There is no fire alarm present on the ceiling.
